kg-block: Chinmaya Balkrishna is a building in the shape of a tortoise, which is constructed to equip our Nursery School. This is unique in its style of construction, so as to invoke the imagination of young children and develop a love for nature. The building has 6 Class Rooms, Teachers' Room, Headmistress's Room, Central Assembly Hall, and Modern Neat Toilets. It is constructed in a well ventilated and environmental friendly manner. The building also boasts of an Air Conditioned Auditorium
main-block: It consists of administrative block, auditorium ,middle school, secondary and senior secondary classes.
A fully equipped and neatly furnished auditorium which can accommodate around 500 students
saraswathy-temple: The Vidyalaya is blessed by a Saraswathy Temple in its campus. Students and teachers begin their day by invoking the blessings of Goddess Saraswathi.
chinmaya-balaniketan: Chinmaya Balaniketan is a residential home away from home. The hostel is situated in the Vidyalaya campus.
Accommodation is available for boys and girls.
chinmaya-vishram: A comfortable guest house keeps its doors open to welcome our special guests and parents.
chinmaya-saket: A quaint residential place for our local Acharya coupled with an Annakshetra and Student Welfare Counter.
chinmaya-darshan: CHINMAYA DARSHANA permanent photo exhibition that portrays the inspiring life of Poojya Gurudev His Holiness Swami Chinmayanandaji, his vision and mission. This creative and aesthetic presentation takes one to a journey with the Great Master.
